issues.problem: Context 2 (就他一个人…) could be filled just as well by 泼冷水, a near-synonym in the same set: objecting to a plan alone does not show taking the opposite line.
issues.action: Rewrote it so he insists on the opposite plan (非要去看电影), which only 唱反调 fits.

issues.problem: Contexts 3 and 6 were about effort or hard work coming to nothing, where 泡汤 (same set) fits equally well.
issues.action: Rewrote both around money already paid in (tuition fees; the millions invested in a cancelled project), the core use that separates it from 泡汤.

issues.problem: Misuse 1 (a basketball player with big hands and feet) is not clearly wrong: a native reader can take the four characters literally as a description of the body.
issues.action: Replaced it with a clear meaning error: using it to mean living frugally when money is short.

Checked the story: the popular tale of Qing bannermen staging collisions with fake porcelain is folk etymology and not certain.
